purpose: Design of document search: pre-search staleness judgment, the search result contract with the read-only search AI, and DLID resolution via resolve-dlid.
summary: Pre-search check distinguishes rebuild-not-needed, rebuild-needed and undeterminable states
Rebuild-needed prompts a user choice between rebuilding first or searching the existing version
Scale counts go to stdout while per-document details go to a detail file under .temp
Undeterminable state stops the search and reports the target and cause, never falling back to an old version
Search result candidates carry document ID, recorded path, reason, sections, ToC version and freshness
Search AI reads every entry of a ToC copy and prefers recall over precision
ToC copy contents: document info fields and section IDs with headings, no paths, hashes or references
resolve-dlid resolves DLIDs from recorded paths and verifies them against file frontmatter or heading suffix
Resolved results include content hashes; unresolved cases return recorded paths or no-record without exploring elsewhere
Search and resolution never write to the ToC, management state or indexed documents
tasks: Implementing or changing the query-docs search flow
Designing the search AI input and output contract
Handling stale ToC or undeterminable states in search
title: DES-006 文書検索設計
